atom_contract: @digits; and balanced square/brace/angle constructs opaque; all other characters literal case-sensitive atoms; malformed @entities and unmatched delimiters fail
blinding_limit: Focal target values and finality omitted from selection keys; neighbouring literals retained and overlaps may permit reconstruction. Procedural separation, not cryptographic blinding or previously untouched data.
claim_ceiling: Inventory and upper-bound capacity only; no semantic edge, no direction test, no allography/meaning, no global normalization; alternate editions are sensitivity channels, not independent witnesses.
family_contract: identical key per edition, at least two occurrences; no requirement to observe both target endings
gap_contract: DEFINITE_SPACE and admissible physical line join become GAP for matching only; UNCERTAIN_SMALL_SPACE remains distinct; drawing interruptions split streams
independence_contract: join recurrent context families sharing any physical leaf f<number> (both sides and panels); one target-blind lexicographically first same-known-hand cross-layout pair per component
key_contract: complete target group minus its explicit final l/m, plus exactly twelve atoms left/right including intervening gap kinds; no target ending or layout in key
paragraph_contract: explicitly bounded ZL paragraph; split on non-P records, missing/nonconsecutive numeric loci or source rows; never cross page/panel; alternate entire segment requires exact same locus sequence and consecutive source rows; borrow ZL paragraph flags
primary_certainty: all atoms in key are ASCII letters or complete @digits; entities and all included gaps are GAP; all other candidates retained as annotated sensitivity only
